title: Signals
description: Environment data provided by the platform to support authorization and abuse prevention. Values MUST NOT be buyer-asserted claims — platforms provide signals based on direct observation or independently verifiable third-party attestations. All signal keys MUST use reverse-domain naming to ensure provenance and prevent collisions when multiple extensions contribute to the shared namespace.

dev.ucp.user_agent.description: Client's HTTP User-Agent header or equivalent.

dev.ucp.instruction_provenance.description: Origin of the instruction that produced this purchase, as observed by the platform running the agent. `user_turn` means the purchase traces to the buyer's own input; `agent_plan` to the agent's own planning; `tool_output` and `retrieved_content` to data the agent read during the task. Distinct from delegated authority: delegation establishes that the buyer authorized the agent to spend, provenance establishes what caused this particular spend.

dev.ucp.agent_spend_context.description: This transaction's amount relative to the agent's own observed spending history, computed by the platform. Absolute amounts are weak signals for agent traffic, where a figure that is routine for one agent is anomalous for another.

baseline_p50.description: Median prior transaction amount for this agent, as a decimal string in the transaction currency.

baseline_p95.description: 95th percentile prior transaction amount for this agent, as a decimal string in the transaction currency.

observation_count.description: Number of prior transactions the baseline is computed over. A low count means the baseline is weak, and receivers SHOULD weight it accordingly.

dev.ucp.payee_continuity.description: Whether the payment destination for this counterparty matches destinations the agent has previously settled to, as observed by the platform. This is a scoring input and is NOT sufficient grounds for a decline on its own: field data shows destination changes are predominantly legitimate.

known_payee.description: Whether the platform has previously observed this agent settling to this destination.

changed_since_last.description: Whether the destination differs from the most recent settlement to this counterparty.

settlements_observed.description: Number of prior settlements to this counterparty the determination is based on.

dev.ucp.request_retry_context.description: Distinguishes a retry of a previously attempted purchase from a distinct purchase. Where settlement failures are common, an induced duplicate charge and an honest retry are otherwise indistinguishable.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key identifying the logical purchase across attempts.

attempt.description: 1 for a first attempt, incrementing per retry of the same logical purchase.

dev.ucp.agent_instance_continuity.description: Opaque, platform-scoped identifier for the agent instance, stable across sessions. Lets a business relate a request to prior behavior by the same agent without the platform disclosing the agent's identity.
